title: HHS-02: GAO-18-564 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-18-564 Recommendation 1 remains Open – Partially Addressed. Its normalized follow-through state is Partially addressed; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open – Partially Addressed; status period: February 2026.

Response artifact: National risk tool, reorganization, and staffing actions. CMS created then suspended a risk and staffing-capacity tool and later changed organization and staffing; GAO still requires a national risk assessment.
Artifact availability: Actions described on the GAO page; underlying tool is not linked.
Named milestone: None stated; milestone state: No named date.
GAO review state: GAO classifies the recommendation Open – Partially Addressed.
Remaining gap: A current national Medicaid program-integrity risk assessment tied to oversight-resource allocation.

Continuation rule: Recheck for a completed national assessment and evidence that it informs resource allocation. Preserve HHS-02 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves HHS-02 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
